name: redact
description: Rewrites sensitive data (emails, IPs, credentials, addresses, phone numbers) out of what enters the model context

emails.title: Redact email addresses
emails.description: Mask email addresses (example.com, noreply and git@ remotes are kept)

ipAddresses.title: Redact IP addresses
ipAddresses.description: Mask IPv4 and IPv6 addresses (loopback, documentation ranges and version numbers are kept)

credentials.title: Redact keys and credentials
credentials.description: Mask API keys, tokens, JWTs, private key blocks, URL passwords and secret assignments

addresses.title: Redact residential addresses
addresses.description: Mask street addresses and Chinese road-and-number addresses

phoneNumbers.title: Redact phone numbers
phoneNumbers.description: Mask phone numbers with a country code, separators, a mobile prefix or a label; bare digit runs are never touched

scrubPrompt.title: Also scrub typed prompts
scrubPrompt.description: Additionally rewrite secrets in rows the user typed; off by default so the model sees what was asked

quiet.title: Quiet mode
quiet.description: Suppress the toast shown when a row is redacted
